title: PackageActivityAttempt
description: Internal sequencing state for one occurrence attempt within a package registration.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

parent_attempt_id.description: Owning cluster attempt, absent only for the root.
parent_attempt_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

sco_state_id.description: Associated current SCO state, when applicable.
sco_state_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

ordinal.description: Activity attempt counter scoped to registration and occurrence.

completed.description: Completion result interpreted only when known.

experienced_duration_ms.description: Time spent actively experiencing this activity, excluding suspension.

progress_measure.description: Known normalized progress measure in [0,1] or omitted when unknown.

selected_child_ids.description: Frozen selected and ordered child occurrence IDs when selection applies.
selected_child_ids.x-reference-scope: Each child is under this exact occurrence.

attempt_mode.description: Authorized creation scope. Only eligible credit attempts contribute official evidence.

x-invariants: Knownness and Boolean result are independent.
Frozen child order is reused on resume.
An ungraded or preview context uses a distinct attempt-mode namespace and does not consume the official attempt count.
